Some nights, when the fog rolled in thick and the sea seemed endless, he would take it out and read it again, feeling a little less alone in his tower of light.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按了静音键。路灯还亮着，橘黄色的光洒在空荡荡的马路上，没有行人，只有偶尔驶过的出租车。便利店的玻璃窗透出一点暖意，店员趴在柜台上打着瞌睡。远处传来垃圾车收运的声音，清脆又孤独。高楼的轮廓在天边渐渐发白，夜色还没完全退去，白昼也还没真正到来。这是一座城市最安静的时刻，所有的喧嚣都暂时沉睡，只留下风穿过街道的声音，和少数还醒着的人，各自怀着心事，看着天边那一点微光。", "w03": "Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem.\nImagine Russian nesting dolls: each doll opens to reveal a smaller one, until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open anymore, that's called the base case.\nThe function keeps calling itself on smaller pieces until it hits that base case, then all the answers combine to solve the original big problem."}
